A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''petty officer''' was a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] [[Time/Legends|sometime]] before [[28 ABY/Legends|27.5 ABY]]. He served under [[Sith Saber]] [[Gavar Khai]] in the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Tribe's [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|armada]] around [[44 ABY]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], he traveled with Sith Saber [[Tola Annax]] to the planet [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]], where he took part in an [[First duel in Kesla Vein|attack]] on the [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]], and the rogue [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]]. During the fight, he [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]] Vestara Khai and was [[Shiak|stabbed]] through the [[Heart/Legends|heart]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]<ref name="Conviction" /> [[Time/Legends|sometime]] before around [[28 BBY/Legends|27.5 ABY]]<ref name="Date" /> and was [[Sith training|trained]] by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], descendants of a group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who had been stranded on the world thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before. The Human ascended to the rank of [[Sith Saber]] and served fellow Saber [[Gavar Khai]] as a [[Petty Officer/Legends|petty officer]] in the [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|Lost Tribe's armada]].<ref name="Conviction" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC" /> the petty [[Officer/Legends|officer]] was part of a Sith task force sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]] to [[Operation Shieldfall|capture]] or [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Abeloth]], a powerful [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Destructors|entity]].<ref name="Conviction" />

[[File:Vestara-Ascension.jpg|thumb|right|175px|Vestara Khai, who killed the Saber]]
During the mission, the petty officer, along with [[Unidentified Sith Saber (Ben Skywalker victim)|two]] [[Unidentified Sith Saber (Luke Skywalker victim)|other]] Sabers, served under the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] Saber [[Tola Annax]]. After landing on the world, the officer and his companions [[First duel in Kesla Vein|ambushed]] the [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], Skywalker's son, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]], and the rogue [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]]&mdash;the daughter of his commanding officer, Gavar Khai. Like the Sith, the Jedi were also searching for Abeloth. Near the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Kesla Vein]], the three Human Sabers [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|engaged]] their opponents in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], although Annax stayed behind. The petty officer dueled Vestara Khai and was able to gain the upper hand in the combat. However, when he used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|throw]] some stones at her, the younger Sith kicked one of the stones in the direction of the Saber's face. When the petty officer tried to block the attack, Vestara [[Shiak|stabbed]] the Sith through his [[Heart/Legends|heart]], killing him instantly.<ref name="Conviction" />

==Personality and traits==
The Sith was in good physical condition during the mission on Nam Chorios, and he had an athletic and solid build. He was able to reach the rank of Sith Saber in the Tribe. While dueling Vestara, he had no qualms about using the Force, even though doing so had catastrophic [[Force storm (weather)|consequences]] for the planet, as the [[tsil]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] on Nam Chorios greatly boosted and redirected the Force energy.<ref name="Conviction" />

==Powers and abilities==
When combating Vestara Khai, the younger Sith recognized that her opponent had no grace in his actions and instead attacked like a [[Tank/Legends|tank]]. The Sith was able to levitate stones by using the Force and attack Vestara with them. However, the younger Sith was able to surprise her opponent and kill him after a short fight.<ref name="Conviction" />

==Equipment==
While on his mission on Nam Chorios, he wore the standard attire of settlers there. During the duel, he used a [[Color/Legends|red]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Conviction" />

==Behind the scenes==
The petty officer appeared in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]'', the seventh novel of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series. ''Conviction'' was written by author [[Aaron Allston]] and was published in [[2011]].<ref name="Conviction" />
